**brain** turns ordinary browsers into a verified AI compute network. Contributors open a tab and earn from real revenue for work the server has checked. Developers get an OpenAI-compatible API that routes each request to the cheapest valid target and issues a proof-of-compute receipt.

### Principles

- Contributors are adversarial until verified. Nothing client-reported is trusted.
- Real and simulated numbers are never mixed. Every figure carries its provenance.
- Unknown is a valid value. We do not estimate prices or hardware.
- Zero verified compute earns zero. No emissions, no passive staking, no promised returns.
